[[Steve Moses]]|hometown = Scranton, PA |occupation = Dentist|TwitterUserName = RockstarDMD|InstagramUserName = rockstar_dentist|Currently1 = Jury Member}} '''Dr. John Robert "Johnny Mac" McGuire''' was a houseguest on ''[[Big Brother 17 (US)]].'' John is best known for his loud, comedic Diary Room presence and surprisingly strong competition ability, despite being one of the most frequently nominated players in the game. He repeatedly saved himself from eviction through competition wins—earning multiple Power of Veto victories and a Battle of the Block win. John formed close working relationships with [[Becky Burgess]] and [[Steve Moses]], while positioning [[Vanessa Rousso]] as his main strategic target due to her perceived control of the house. After being evicted in Week 9 while on the block with Steve, he returned to the game by winning the jury buyback, briefly re-entered the power structure, and even cooperated with former enemies while shifting his focus toward the [[Austwins]]. Despite managing to lay low and improve his social game with the remaining houseguests, Vanessa evicted him on Day 91, because of her suspicions of a possible final two deal he made with Steve. He placed 4th, and became the 8th member of the jury. On finale night, John along with [[Jason Roy]] and [[James Huling]] was revealed to be the top three to win America's Favorite HouseGuest but lost to James.
